theorem lg_target {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {P₁ P₂ : RingPreordering R} : ↑P₁ < ↑P₂ ↔ P₁ < P₂ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm (le_subsemiring_iff.1 h) (le_subsemiring_iff.2 h)
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm (le_subsemiring_iff.2 h) (le_subsemiring_iff.1 h)
